items.title: SK Hynix Stock Rises ~13% in Nasdaq Debut, Latest Sign of AI Demand
items.desc: The South Korean memory-chip maker opened at $170 versus its $149 IPO price and rose about 13% on Friday in its US trading debut, the latest trillion-dollar listing testing investor appetite for AI-related companies whose chips underpin data-center infrastructure. [posted Jul 10, 2026]
